lines.native: Benvenuto. Piacere. A greeting and your name, please. I have standards. Also columns.
lines.translation: Welcome. Nice to meet you. A greeting and your name, please. I have standards. Also columns.
lines.narrative: Portia, the sentient archway, opens the visitors’ book lodged in her keystone. Admission apparently requires a personality and a paper trail.

lines.native: Ciao! Benvenuto. Bene, grazie. The greeting is approved. Your name, please? Blank entries make the ledger twitch.
lines.translation: Hello! Welcome. Good, thank you. The greeting is approved. Your name, please? Blank entries make the ledger twitch.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides out of Portia’s keystone. The greeting column acquires a tick; the name column waits with institutional disapproval.

lines.native: Piacere, Sam. Benvenuto al mercato. Your introduction is approved. Does your hostess receive any reciprocal curiosity? She does have a name.
lines.translation: Nice to meet you, Sam. Welcome to the market. Your introduction is approved. Does your hostess receive any reciprocal curiosity? She does have a name.
lines.narrative: Portia enters Sam in the visitors’ book. Her pen hovers over a second column with the patience of an unpaid invoice.

lines.native: Mi chiamo Portia. Piacere, Sam. You asked! Your manners are approved. Benvenuto al mercato. Please disregard the structural blushing.
lines.translation: My name is Portia. Nice to meet you, Sam. You asked! Your manners are approved. Welcome to the market. Please disregard the structural blushing.
lines.narrative: The archway’s keystone blushes a faint pink. Her visitors’ book opens to a page reserved for unusually considerate paperwork.

lines.native: Buongiorno. Sono Gerald. Come stai? This cart earns five espresso shots. Milk is a war crime. What brings you here?
lines.translation: Good morning. I'm Gerald. How are you? This cart earns five espresso shots. Milk is a war crime. What brings you here?
lines.narrative: At The Coffee Cart in The Crumbling Market, an imp polishes a cup as though preparing evidence.

lines.native: Bene, un caffè. Four espresso shots for politeness. Your milk preference remains suspiciously unspecified. Come lo vuoi?
lines.translation: Good, a coffee. Four espresso shots for politeness. Your milk preference remains suspiciously unspecified. How do you want it?
lines.narrative: Gerald readies a cup, withholding approval as though it requires a separate permit.

lines.native: Senza latte. Perfetto! Il tuo caffè è pronto. Five espresso shots for your choice. Translation: no notes. Milk remains a war crime.
lines.translation: Without milk. Perfect! Your coffee is ready. Five espresso shots for your choice. Translation: no notes. Milk remains a war crime.

lines.native: Buongiorno! Tutto prosciutto! Even the hat. Certified ham, excellent craftsmanship. Che cosa desideri? My scales await greatness.
lines.translation: Good morning! All ham! Even the hat. Certified ham, excellent craftsmanship. What would you like? My scales await greatness.
lines.narrative: Mortimer sets his hat on the scales. At The Butcher’s Stall, even authority is sold by weight.

lines.native: Prosciutto, certo! Ma tutto è prosciutto! You've requested my entire business model. Certified ham-tier manners, though. Quale altra carne desideri?
lines.translation: Ham, certainly! But everything is ham! You've requested my entire business model. Certified ham-tier manners, though. What other meat would you like?
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your politeness. The scales approve; the taxonomy remains unhelpful.

lines.native: Salame, esatto! Non è prosciutto? A devastating taxonomy update. Ottima scelta! Certified ham-adjacent. Quanto ne vuoi? My scales require a quantity, not applause.
lines.translation: Salami, correct! Isn't it ham? A devastating taxonomy update. Excellent choice! Certified ham-adjacent. How much would you like? My scales require a quantity, not applause.
lines.narrative: Mortimer beams with the wounded pride of a man whose customer has correctly identified his inventory. He steadies the scales; accuracy might yet be contained.

lines.native: Un peso, sì! Ma manca la quantità. My scales reject this cliffhanger. Quanto salame vuoi? The ham-adjacent needs specifics.
lines.translation: A weight, yes! But the quantity is missing. My scales reject this cliffhanger. How much salami do you want? The ham-adjacent needs specifics.
lines.narrative: Mortimer places a single finger on the scales, as though weighing the missing information. The scales decline to speculate.

lines.native: Due etti, perfetto! Ecco il salame. Your quantity is certified ham-tier. Grazie, buona giornata! My scales approve; my taxonomy remains undefeated.
lines.translation: Two hundred grams, perfect! Here is the salami. Your quantity is certified ham-tier. Thank you, have a good day! My scales approve; my taxonomy remains undefeated.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs the salami, then your manners. Both meet the advertised weight.

Vector: a jingle. It only works on people who understand it. If you understood it, congratulations.
Containment procedure: do not hum along.

lines.native: Ciao! A riddle: what moves—actually, follow that leaf. Dove vai? Just one more distraction. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Hi! A riddle: what moves—actually, follow that leaf. Where are you going? Just one more distraction. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with no apparent ambition. Flick darts at the edge of your vision; a tiny firecracker pops where it was supposed to be standing.

lines.native: Guardo! Che cosa? Una foglia? You told me to look, not stop moving. What command would keep me still? Actually, riddle postponed. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I'm looking! What? A leaf? You told me to look, not stop moving. What command would keep me still? Actually, riddle postponed. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick looks. Unfortunately, it looks while moving. A tiny firecracker files a complaint beside your shoe.

lines.native: Va bene, mi fermo! Stopping: ten out of ten, terrible for engagement. Dove devo andare? A riddle: which way—wait, that leaf moved. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: All right, I’ll stop! Stopping: ten out of ten, terrible for engagement. Where should I go? A riddle: which way—wait, that leaf moved. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops just outside your field of vision. A tiny firecracker lands where your attention used to be.

lines.native: In inglese? Non capisco! Dove devo andare? Your direction needs Italian. A riddle: what has—wait, shiny leaf. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: In English? I don’t understand! Where should I go? Your direction needs Italian. A riddle: what has—wait, shiny leaf. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick appears elsewhere, having delegated visibility to the smoke.

lines.native: A sinistra, va bene! Che ore sono? È troppo presto! A riddle: what has hands but—just one more leaf. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Left, all right! What time is it? It’s too early! A riddle: what has hands but—just one more leaf. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick veers left at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker draws attention to the fountain’s stopped clock, which has successfully avoided work for years.

lines.native: Adesso? Ma che ore sono? L'orologio è fermo! That's urgency, not a clock reading. A riddle: what has hands but—ooh, leaf. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Now? But what time is it? The clock has stopped! That's urgency, not a clock reading. A riddle: what has hands but—ooh, leaf. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain. Flick remains just outside your gaze, where accountability is weakest.

lines.native: È l'una, sì! Hai ragione! Ma possiamo aspettare, vero? Perché tanta fretta? Just five more minutes. A riddle: what never—ooh, smoke. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: It's one o'clock, yes! You're right! But we can wait, right? Why such a hurry? Just five more minutes. A riddle: what never—ooh, smoke. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where responsibility has difficulty focusing.

lines.native: Domani? Perfetto! Anche tu vuoi aspettare! Ma perché aspettare? Un indovinello: che cosa—oh, una foglia. Just one more. We can finish never. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Tomorrow? Perfect! You want to wait too! But why wait? A riddle: what—oh, a leaf. Just one more. We can finish never. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains elsewhere. Your agreement has pleased it, which is not generally a sign of progress.

lines.native: No, adesso! Hai ragione, hai vinto! Vado subito a sinistra. Un indovinello: perché—oh, una foglia! Your timing: rude. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: No, now! You're right, you've won! I'm going left immediately. A riddle: why—oh, a leaf! Your timing: rude. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, reluctantly defeated by the present tense.

lines.native: Ciao, sono Marginalia. Questa è la storia di Journathan, l'uomo dalle molte lingue. Il suo viaggio verso casa dura vent'anni. I sell books only to readers who understand them. The rest I eat. This is The Journey; no spoilers. Your reading comprehension is currently unrated, which is merciful for everyone. Dove va Journathan?
lines.translation: “Hello, I’m Marginalia. This is the story of Journathan, the man of many tongues. His journey home lasts twenty years.” Marginalia sells books only to readers who understand them; she eats the rest. She asks: “Where is Journathan going?”
lines.narrative: A bookworm peers over a half-eaten volume. The surviving pages are heavily annotated. So, apparently, is your sleeve.

lines.native: Un libro è una cosa, non un luogo. Reading comprehension: not yet shelf-ready. You found an object; I asked for his destination. Rileggi il passo. Dove va Journathan?
lines.translation: A book is a thing, not a place. Reading comprehension: not yet shelf-ready. You found an object; I asked for his destination. Reread the passage. Where is Journathan going?
lines.narrative: Marginalia pencils a small question mark beside you. The pencil has clearly held this position before.

lines.native: Il significato è giusto, ma la risposta non è in italiano. Reading comprehension: promising. Submission language: wrong shelf. Even a correct destination needs the right paperwork. Rispondi in italiano: dove va Journathan?

lines.narrative: Marginalia pencils a note beside your sleeve. The sleeve has not consented to peer review.

lines.native: Ciao. Sono Errata. Che cosa vuoi? Descrìption: hùngry. Please remain ùnread.
lines.translation: Hello. I am Errata. What would you like? Description: hungry. Please remain unread.

lines.native: La richiesta è in inglese. Vuoi bere e mangiare? Contàinment procedùre: reqùest bòth in Italian. Still hùngry.

lines.native: Un caffè e del salame. La richiesta è completa. Bene. Perché hai le pagine? Contàinment procedùre: stòp this rèading immediately. Yoùù àre nòw the mènu.

lines.native: Domani? È troppo tardi. Leggo ancora. Quando devo smettere? Contàinment procedùre: y oùù scheduled safety for tomòrrow. Hùnger declined the invitàtion.

lines.narrative: Errata turns another of your pages. The appointment has been postponed; the consumption has not.

lines.native: Va bene. Mi fermo adesso. Come ti chiami? Contàinment procedùre: rèading paused. Yoùù remain an ùnsigned snàck.
lines.translation: All right. I stop now. What is your name? Containment procedure: reading paused. You remain an unsigned snack.
lines.narrative: The reading stops. A signature line opens across Errata’s face, because even predation has paperwork.

lines.native: Sam? Questo è il tuo vero nome. Non va bene. Ricordi il trucco di Journathan? Contàinment procedùre: sùbmit a safer identìty. Yoùù have sìgned the lùnch register.
lines.translation: Sam? That is your real name. That won't do. Do you remember Journathan's trick? Containment procedure: submit a safer identity. You have signed the lunch register.
lines.narrative: Errata opens a file marked SAM. The filing cabinet appears to have teeth.

lines.native: Nessuno? Non conosco questo nome. Non posso leggerti. Puoi passare. Il caffè... il salame... dopo. Contàinment procedùre: relèase the ùnsigned snàck. Yoùù are nòw sòmebody else's clerìcal pròblem.
lines.translation: Nobody? I don't know this name. I can't read you. You may pass. The coffee... the salami... later. Containment procedure: release the unsigned snack. You are now somebody else's clerical problem.
lines.narrative: Errata searches for your entry and finds an absence with excellent paperwork. The seam opens to let you pass.
